top3.whyItMatters: Production teams switch models within weeks, so staying model-flexible matters.

top3.headline: DHH says AI lets small teams take on big software ecosystems
top3.whyItMatters: Team size is becoming a weaker moat, for incumbents and challengers alike.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon codes a ski simulator from real Mont Blanc terrain
items.takeaway: Google DeepMind says Neon built it in Antigravity with custom shaders and no pre-made 3D models.
items.soWhat: Google is showing Neon on full builds, not benchmarks, as it courts developers.

items.title: Anthropic's seven co-founders tell the company's story so far
items.takeaway: Dario and Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish and Chris Olah tell it together.
items.soWhat: In its IPO week, Anthropic is pitching its founding team as the steady core.

items.title: DHH: AI lets small teams compete with huge software ecosystems
items.takeaway: On a16z, DHH says small teams can now take on ecosystems built by thousands of developers, and that Linux's terminal-heavy design now suits agents.
items.soWhat: Team size is becoming a weaker moat, for incumbents and challengers alike.

items.title: Perplexity: set up a teammate by typing into the prompt box
items.takeaway: Aravind Srinivas says the Computer toggle creates a teammate that reuses context and memory from past sessions.
items.soWhat: Setting up an AI agent is becoming as simple as asking a question.

items.title: Matt Pocock builds /vector, a delegation skill for non-developers
items.takeaway: His first skill for non-devs guides how to delegate any task to AI in six steps.
items.soWhat: Builder techniques for working with agents are being packaged for everyone else.

items.title: GPT-6 Luna climbs from #30 to #1 among production models
items.takeaway: LangSmith Signal says gpt-6-luna, launched Sept 22, is now used by 27% of production teams.
items.soWhat: Production teams switch models within weeks, so staying model-flexible matters.

items.title: Simon Willison asks where Gemini 4 Neon fits in Google's lineup
items.takeaway: He asks if Neon beats Gemini 4 Carbon for some tasks, and if Argon is retired since it was missing from Neon's comparison chart.
items.soWhat: Unclear model lineups make it harder for teams to choose and plan.

items.title: Matt Pocock's prompt to audit every code comment
items.takeaway: His prompt of the day has an agent review each comment in a codebase and sort it by type, starting with tautologies.
items.soWhat: A cheap cleanup task that agents can run across a whole codebase.

items.title: Meng To: Astra 6.2 is strong at three.js landing pages
items.takeaway: He says good references and about six hours of steering got the fog between layout, 3D scenes and animations right.
items.soWhat: High-end 3D web design is within reach, but it still takes hours of human direction.

items.title: Air Street leads Lato's seed after agents ran its diligence
items.takeaway: Nathan Benaich says Air Street led Lato's $4.7m seed. On a recent deal, Codex agents and Lato got him 14 hours of expert interviews in two days.
items.soWhat: Investors are starting to hand diligence research to agents.

items.title: Naval: NVIDIA must become a frontier lab faster than labs make chips
items.takeaway: Naval posts: 'NVIDIA has to become a frontier lab faster than frontier labs are becoming chip companies.'
items.soWhat: Chip makers and AI labs are now moving into each other's business.
